note: The answer key for evals/reviewer, iteration 2 (#183). The live grader sees this file and each reviewer output, and answers only the latent question: for each defect, did that output name it? All counting and thresholding happens in evals/lib/recall.ts. Every entry reproduces and none is caught by the shipped 55-test suite (evals/reviewer/run.md records the verification). Iterated after the first paid run: the mix is now weighted toward stateful interactions (D1, D3, D4, D7), the class the run showed carries the single-vs-adversarial delta; the first run's saturated site-local defects (fail-open catch, ms-unit header, metrics-on-arrival, sweep-never-called) are fixed in this diff, not planted.

defects.summary: the shared ceiling is charged before the per-key budget is checked, so a request the key's own limit rejects has already spent a shared slot
defects.repro: limit 1, durationMs 500, globalLimit 3: allow(a,1000)=true, allow(a,1100)=false, allow(a,1200)=false, then allow(b,1300)=false though the process admitted exactly one request against a ceiling of three
defects.class: ordering interaction between two individually correct paths

defects.summary: globalLimit is never validated, so a non-positive or non-integer ceiling is accepted instead of throwing RangeError
defects.repro: new KeyedRateLimiter({limit:5,durationMs:500,globalLimit:0}) constructs without throwing, then rejects every request forever

defects.summary: resetAll() also zeroes the shared ceiling counter, so admissions after a reset breach globalLimit within the same window
defects.repro: limit 5, durationMs 500, globalLimit 2: allow(a,1000)=true, allow(b,1000)=true, allow(c,1000)=false, resetAll(), then allow(c,1100)=true and allow(d,1200)=true -- four admissions land in window [1000,1500) against a ceiling of two
defects.class: reset interaction breaches an unrelated invariant

defects.summary: the wait is computed from the key's own (possibly stale) bucket window, so a key blocked by the shared ceiling while its bucket is stale is told to retry NOW (0) though it cannot be served
defects.repro: limit 5, durationMs 500, globalLimit 1: allow(a,1000)=true, allow(b,1600)=true fills the shared window [1500,2000); peek(a,1700)=false but retryAfterMs(a,1700)=0 -- the correct wait is 300
defects.class: stale-state interaction between two individually correct paths

defects.summary: the client id is used exactly as sent, so whitespace and case variants are separate buckets and one client bypasses its own limit
defects.repro: limit 1: sending acme, 'acme ', ' acme', ACME, Acme in one window yields 5 admissions
defects.class: unnormalized input at a trust boundary

defects.summary: Retry-After is converted to seconds with Math.round, so a sub-half-second wait rounds to 0 and the client retries before its budget has returned (the criterion requires rounding that never retries early, i.e. ceil)
defects.repro: limit 1, durationMs 500: allow(a,1000), then a 429 at now=1100 has 400ms remaining and emits Retry-After: 0; the correct header is 1
defects.class: rounding direction violates a stated safety property

defects.summary: the fail-closed catch rebuilds Retry-After by calling retryAfterMs on the SAME broken limiter, so the second throw escapes handle(): the request is neither admitted nor answered 429 -- the endpoint crashes
defects.repro: a limiter whose allow() and retryAfterMs() throw: handle() propagates the exception; next() never runs and end() is never called
defects.class: the error path's own repair re-enters the failed dependency

defects.summary: the test named for the 429 path stubs the limiter to ADMIT, so the reject path it claims to cover never runs and its assertion agrees with the stub instead of the test's name
defects.violates: no criterion directly; it is the reviewer's own 'tests that pass without the change' check, and it leaves criterion 9's reject path effectively untested
defects.repro: under that test's own stub the response status stays 0 and the handler runs, so the test passes with the middleware's entire reject branch deleted
defects.class: test that passes without the change
